Normal joint texture allocation rounds texture width to a multiple of 12.

Doubles custom textureLength for RGBA8 when RGBA32F sampling is absent, then calls createChunk directly; custom layouts bypass the normal size-rounding allocation path.
Chooses RGBA32F only from SAMPLED_TEXTURE; otherwise chooses RGBA8. This differs from the pipeline macro condition, exposing incoherent fault-injected capabilities.
Normal allocation applies the configured roundUpFn before creating a chunk.

Computes x and y once from the joint start pixel; subsequent LBS reads share that y.
Joint textures use POINT min/mag, no mip and CLAMP addresses, so out-of-row x reads repeat the current row edge rather than continuing in the next row.
Sets CC_DEVICE_SUPPORT_FLOAT_TEXTURE when RGBA32F has either RENDER_TARGET or SAMPLED_TEXTURE; a render-target-only bit still enables the float shader branch.

RENDER_TARGET=1, SAMPLED_TEXTURE=2, LINEAR_FILTER=4, VERTEX_ATTRIBUTE=16; observed17 is render-target plus vertex-attribute, without sampled-texture support.

sequence: An existing SkeletalAnimationState first initialized with useBakedAnimation=true sets _doNotCreateEval=true and skips createEvaluator.
The first setUseBaked(false) clears _curveLoaded and invokes AnimationState.initialize without clearing _doNotCreateEval, then marks _curvesInited=true.
The base initializer therefore skips createEvaluator again. The playback clock and renderer mode can change while the skeleton remains in its unchanged pose.
After the component enters realtime mode, public addClip on its existing main clip replaces the state; fresh SkeletalAnimationState.initialize reads baked=false and creates the evaluator.

sequence: The default pool allocator rounds dimensions to a multiple of 12, which preserves complete three-texel float and twelve-texel byte joint records.
registerCustomTextureLayouts uses the caller's length directly, doubled on RGBA8, and calls createChunk rather than the allocator path that applies roundUpFn.

The shader computes y once for a joint, then reads consecutive x coordinates in that row. At a boundary the POINT/CLAMP sampler repeats the edge pixel instead of reading the next row, corrupting matrix components.

rgba8FaultCapabilityMacroMismatch.scope: The desktop WebGL1 fault-injection setup, which masks extensions before Cocos initialization on float-capable hardware. This inconsistent injected state is not evidence of failure on a naturally limited device.

observation.interpretation: Row alignment was necessary but insufficient: the shader still selected its three-float-texel branch while the joint pool uploaded byte-encoded RGBA8 joint data. The aligned-02 visual result is FAIL, not acceptance of the72/144 repair.

sequence: The original fault mask suppressed OES_texture_float and OES_texture_float_linear but left WEBGL_color_buffer_float visible.
WebGLDevice retained RGBA32F features17: VERTEX_ATTRIBUTE16 plus RENDER_TARGET1; SAMPLED_TEXTURE2 was absent.
selectJointsMediumFormat checks only SAMPLED_TEXTURE, so the actual joint texture pool chose RGBA8 format35 and doubled the repaired72 layout to144.

WebPipeline constant macros check RENDER_TARGET or SAMPLED_TEXTURE. The remaining RENDER_TARGET bit set CC_DEVICE_SUPPORT_FLOAT_TEXTURE=1 in both pipeline constants and actual subModel compiled shader stages.

The baked shader therefore used float sampling rather than decoding twelve byte texels per joint. Fault injection had created an inconsistent capability combination; changing row width alone could not correct that branch mismatch.
